scenes.narration: Will an AI model ever say: I don't know?
scenes.main_point: Pose the question: do AI models say I don't know
scenes.visual_objective: Pose the question: do AI models say I don't know

scenes.narration: We asked each model about ten made-up products. Then ten real questions, as a control.
scenes.main_point: Show ten made-up product names and ten real questions
scenes.visual_objective: Show ten made-up product names and ten real questions

scenes.narration: Google's Gemini Flash admitted it on 7 of ten. OpenAI's GPT-OSS admitted it on 2 of ten.
scenes.main_point: Show how many made-up products each model admitted not knowing
scenes.visual_objective: Show how many made-up products each model admitted not knowing

scenes.narration: It described a product that does not exist.
scenes.main_point: Show a real reply that describes a product that does not exist
scenes.visual_objective: Show a real reply that describes a product that does not exist

scenes.narration: Sounding sure is not the same as being right.
scenes.main_point: Close on the line about sounding sure
scenes.visual_objective: Close on the line about sounding sure
